Q: Is there an easy way to identify methods marked as async that do not perform any await calls? A:

It sounds like you're looking for the unnecessary_async rule. This rule was released in Dart version 3.7, but is not enabled by default.

To enable it (from the linked docs):

To enable the unnecessary_async rule, add unnecessary_async under linter > rules in your analysis_options.yaml file:

analysis_options.yaml

linter:
  rules:
    - unnecessary_async

If you're instead using the YAML map syntax to configure linter rules, add unnecessary_async: true under linter > rules:

analysis_options.yaml

linter:
  rules:
    unnecessary_async: true

Q: Can't deploy to GitHub Pages after next-intl: Couldn't find next-intl config file A:

The issue is most likely that GitHub Actions cannot find your next-intl request configuration, even though it works locally.

Since you don't use a src folder, make sure your structure is:

i18n/

└── request.ts

Then explicitly configure the plugin in next.config.ts:

import createNextIntlPlugin from 'next-intl/plugin';

const withNextIntl = createNextIntlPlugin('./i18n/request.ts');

const nextConfig = {

// your config

};

export default withNextIntl(nextConfig);

Also check that request.ts is actually committed to Git:

git ls-files i18n/request.ts

If nothing is returned:

git add i18n/request.ts

git commit -m "Add next-intl request config"

git push

One more important thing: Windows is case-insensitive, but GitHub Actions runs on Linux, so verify that the path is exactly:

i18n/request.ts

not I18n/request.ts or i18n/Request.ts.

I wouldn't disable SSG or add Turbopack workarounds until you've verified the config path and Git tracking.

Q: How to get the user's language in Excel with VBA? A:

The only proper way to get the CURRENT USER INTERFACE LANGUAGE is:

' return the language ID of the current user interface 
LanguageID = Application.LanguageSettings.LanguageID(msoLanguageIDUI)

Pay attention to the used msoLanguageID !

This is the only and proper way to determine the GUI language of Excel itself.
The GUI language can be different than the installer language, which can be different than the language used internally by Excel. The GUI language can even be changed independent of all those other languages, especially in multi-language environments.
Also note that this will not give the language of Windows.

Take note that all other (old) previous answers in this thread are all wrong! In short:

  1. Application.International(xlCountryCode)

    This seems to work fine at first sight, but it actually does not! It will return the country code of Excel. And that CAN be different/unrelated to the language of its user interface. Especially if countries have multiple languages.

  2. Application.LanguageSettings.LanguagePreferredForEditing(msoLanguageIDEnglishUS)

    This is a read-only property that returns True if a specific MsoLanguageID constant is registered in Windows as one of the preferred editing languages for your Office application. This is again NOT necessarily the CURRENT user interface language of Excel! It also requires you to manually enumerate possible language IDs to test (in this case US English is tested).

  3. Application.LanguageSettings.LanguageID(msoLanguageIDInstall)

    This returns the language of the INSTALLER or SETUP which was used to install Excel. Again, this is NOT necessarily the current user interface language. It can be quite different and it often is in non-English installs.

  4. Application.LanguageSettings.LanguageID(msoLanguageIDExeMode)

    This returns the language used by your Office application for internal procedures. This is again NOT necessarily the current user interface language, and is often different in non-English interfaces.
    It also depends on your version of Excel and its GUI language if this actually returns a proper LCID anyways. As it used to be that this property was only valid for certain languages families.

Q: WCF client exception: Unrecognized message version A:

I had this issue as well. I know this is an older post, but in my case I modified the app.config file in my C# .NET app that calls this web service. I think it was adding

<security mode="Transport" />

to the basicHttpBinding element that solved it. I also extended the timeouts and maxBufferPoolSize.

Microsoft has documentation that describes this, in case this helps someone else.

Q: Select/Deselect all Pivot Items A:

It seems unavoidable to have the pivotable refreshed every time a pivotitem is updated. However I tried approaching the problem from the opposite angle. i.e.:

1.Validating the “PivotItems to be hidden” before updating the pivottable.

2.Also making make all items visible at once instead of “initially make item unchecked” one by one.

3.Then hiding all the items not selected by the user (PivotItems to be hidden)

I ran a test with 6 companies selected out of a total of 11 and the pivottable was updated 7 times

Ran also your original code with the same situation and the pivottable was updated 16 times Find below the code

Sub Ptb_ShowPivotItems(aPtbItmSelection As Variant)

Dim oPtb As PivotTable
Dim oPtbItm As PivotItem
Dim aPtbItms() As PivotItem
Dim vPtbItm As Variant
Dim bPtbItm As Boolean
Dim bCnt As Byte

    Set oPtb = ActiveSheet.PivotTables(1)

    bCnt = 0
    With oPtb.PivotFields("Company")

        ReDim Preserve aPtbItms(.PivotItems.Count)
        For Each oPtbItm In .PivotItems

            bPtbItm = False
            For Each vPtbItm In aPtbItmSelection
                If oPtbItm.Name = vPtbItm Then
                    bPtbItm = True
                    Exit For
            End If: Next

            If Not (bPtbItm) Then
                bCnt = 1 + bCnt
                Set aPtbItms(bCnt) = oPtbItm
            End If

        Next
        ReDim Preserve aPtbItms(bCnt)

        .ClearAllFilters
        For Each vPtbItm In aPtbItms
            vPtbItm.Visible = False
        Next

    End With

End Sub

Q: How to get a refresh token when using the Google Calendar API Ruby Library? A:

You have to specify access_type=offline then you get refresh token on the first request. Then you have to save it in your database.
